The '''Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant''' was a very rare and furry [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-dwelling creatures.

==History==
Described as a sort of [[kangaroo]]-[[ferret]] cross,<ref>''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> tessellated arboreal binjinphants were incredibly valuable and rare creatures.<ref name=":0">{{DroidsCite|Coby and the Starhunters}}</ref>

[[Ingey]] was the pet binjinphant of [[Coby]] of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].<ref name=":1">{{DroidsCite|The Revenge of Kybo Ren}}</ref> He was kidnapped by [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]] on [[Chuzalla]].<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CuteKangarooLikeBeing.jpg|thumb|Unused concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
The Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant appeared in two episodes of the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] television series.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" /> The creature later received a mention in the online game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', in a quest relating to the [[Holocron of Destiny]].<ref>{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
